from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_FLOOR, ROUND_HALF_UP

# ==========================================
# CONSTANTS SECTION
# ==========================================

# Sec 16(ia) - Standard deduction amounts
STD_DEDUCTION_OLD = Decimal('50000')  # Sec 16(ia) Standard deduction for old regime
STD_DEDUCTION_NEW = Decimal('75000')  # Sec 115BAC Proviso Standard deduction for new regime

# Sec 10(13A) - HRA limits
HRA_METRO_PERCENT = Decimal('0.50')  # Sec 10(13A) Metro city HRA percentage (50%)
HRA_NON_METRO_PERCENT = Decimal('0.40')  # Sec 10(13A) Non-metro city HRA percentage (40%)
HRA_RENT_EXCESS_PERCENT = Decimal('0.10')  # Sec 10(13A) Rent paid in excess of salary percentage (10%)

# Sec 24(b) - House property interest deduction limit
HP_INTEREST_LIMIT_OLD = Decimal('200000')  # Sec 24(b) Max interest deduction for self-occupied house

# Chapter VI-A limits (Old Regime)
SEC_80C_LIMIT = Decimal('150000')  # Sec 80C Maximum aggregate deduction
SEC_80CCD_1B_LIMIT = Decimal('50000')  # Sec 80CCD(1B) Additional NPS deduction limit
SEC_80D_SELF_LIMIT = Decimal('25000')  # Sec 80D Health insurance limit for self/family (non-senior)
SEC_80D_SELF_SR_LIMIT = Decimal('50000')  # Sec 80D Health insurance limit for self/family (senior)
SEC_80D_PARENTS_LIMIT = Decimal('25000')  # Sec 80D Health insurance limit for parents (non-senior)
SEC_80D_PARENTS_SR_LIMIT = Decimal('50000')  # Sec 80D Health insurance limit for parents (senior)

# Sec 87A - Rebate limits and thresholds
REBATE_OLD_LIMIT = Decimal('500000')  # Sec 87A Old regime rebate total income threshold
REBATE_OLD_MAX = Decimal('12500')  # Sec 87A Old regime max rebate amount
REBATE_NEW_LIMIT = Decimal('1200000')  # Sec 87A New regime rebate total income threshold
REBATE_NEW_MAX = Decimal('60000')  # Sec 87A New regime max rebate amount

# Surcharge Thresholds and Rates
SURCHARGE_THRESHOLDS = [
    Decimal('5000000'),    # First surcharge threshold: 50 Lakh
    Decimal('10000000'),   # Second surcharge threshold: 1 Crore
    Decimal('20000000'),   # Third surcharge threshold: 2 Crore
    Decimal('50000000')    # Fourth surcharge threshold: 5 Crore (Old regime only)
]
SURCHARGE_RATES_OLD = [
    Decimal('0.10'),       # Surcharge rate above 50L (10%)
    Decimal('0.15'),       # Surcharge rate above 1Cr (15%)
    Decimal('0.25'),       # Surcharge rate above 2Cr (25%)
    Decimal('0.37')        # Surcharge rate above 5Cr (37%)
]
SURCHARGE_RATES_NEW = [
    Decimal('0.10'),       # Surcharge rate above 50L (10%)
    Decimal('0.15'),       # Surcharge rate above 1Cr (15%)
    Decimal('0.25'),       # Surcharge rate above 2Cr (25%)
    Decimal('0.25')        # Surcharge rate capped at 25% under new regime
]

# Health and Education Cess Rate
CESS_RATE = Decimal('0.04')  # Health and Education Cess rate (4%)

# Tax Slabs (lower, upper_or_None, rate)
# First Schedule, Part III, Para A — Old regime (I) Below 60 years
SLABS_OLD_UNDER_60 = [
    (Decimal('0'), Decimal('250000'), Decimal('0')),
    (Decimal('250000'), Decimal('500000'), Decimal('0.05')),
    (Decimal('500000'), Decimal('1000000'), Decimal('0.20')),
    (Decimal('1000000'), None, Decimal('0.30')),
]

# First Schedule, Part III, Para A — Old regime (II) Senior citizen (60 to 79)
SLABS_OLD_SENIOR = [
    (Decimal('0'), Decimal('300000'), Decimal('0')),
    (Decimal('300000'), Decimal('500000'), Decimal('0.05')),
    (Decimal('500000'), Decimal('1000000'), Decimal('0.20')),
    (Decimal('1000000'), None, Decimal('0.30')),
]

# First Schedule, Part III, Para A — Old regime (III) Super senior citizen (80+)
SLABS_OLD_SUPER_SENIOR = [
    (Decimal('0'), Decimal('500000'), Decimal('0')),
    (Decimal('500000'), Decimal('1000000'), Decimal('0.20')),
    (Decimal('1000000'), None, Decimal('0.30')),
]

# Sec 115BAC(1A)(iii) — New tax regime slabs
SLABS_NEW = [
    (Decimal('0'), Decimal('400000'), Decimal('0')),
    (Decimal('400000'), Decimal('800000'), Decimal('0.05')),
    (Decimal('800000'), Decimal('1200000'), Decimal('0.10')),
    (Decimal('1200000'), Decimal('1600000'), Decimal('0.15')),
    (Decimal('1600000'), Decimal('2000000'), Decimal('0.20')),
    (Decimal('2000000'), Decimal('2400000'), Decimal('0.25')),
    (Decimal('2400000'), None, Decimal('0.30')),
]


def round_nearest_ten(amount: Decimal) -> Decimal:
    """Sec 288A/288B rounding: drop paise (floor to whole rupees), 
    then round to nearest multiple of 10 (5 or more rounds up)."""
    whole_rupees = amount.quantize(Decimal('1'), rounding=ROUND_FLOOR)
    remainder = whole_rupees % Decimal('10')
    if remainder >= Decimal('5'):
        return whole_rupees + (Decimal('10') - remainder)
    else:
        return whole_rupees - remainder


def compute_slabs(taxable_income: Decimal, slabs: list) -> tuple[Decimal, list[tuple[str, Decimal]]]:
    """Computes slab-wise tax and returns total slab tax and a list of (description, amount) per band."""
    total_tax = Decimal('0')
    band_details = []
    for lower, upper, rate in slabs:
        if taxable_income <= lower:
            break
        if upper is None or taxable_income < upper:
            taxable_in_band = taxable_income - lower
        else:
            taxable_in_band = upper - lower
        
        band_tax = taxable_in_band * rate
        total_tax += band_tax
        
        upper_str = f"up to {upper:n}" if upper else "above"
        desc = f"Tax at {rate * Decimal('100')}% on slab {lower:n} to {upper_str}"
        band_details.append((desc, band_tax))
        
    return total_tax, band_details


def compute_regime(inp: dict, is_new_regime: bool) -> dict:
    gross_salary = Decimal(str(inp['gross_salary']))
    age = int(inp['age'])
    hra_received = Decimal(str(inp['hra_received']))
    basic_plus_da = Decimal(str(inp['basic_plus_da']))
    rent_paid = Decimal(str(inp['rent_paid']))
    rent_city_is_metro = bool(inp['rent_city_is_metro'])
    home_loan_interest = Decimal(str(inp['home_loan_interest']))
    sec_80c = Decimal(str(inp['sec_80c']))
    sec_80ccd_1b = Decimal(str(inp['sec_80ccd_1b']))
    health_ins_self = Decimal(str(inp['health_ins_self']))
    health_ins_parents = Decimal(str(inp['health_ins_parents']))
    parents_senior = bool(inp['parents_senior'])

    trace = []

    # 1. Salary / Income components
    trace.append({
        "kind": "income",
        "description": "Gross salary",
        "amount": str(gross_salary),
        "clause": "Sec 17(1)"
    })

    # 2. HRA Exemption (Old regime only)
    hra_exempt = Decimal('0')
    if not is_new_regime and hra_received > 0 and rent_paid > 0:
        excess_rent = rent_paid - (basic_plus_da * HRA_RENT_EXCESS_PERCENT)
        if excess_rent > 0:
            city_percent = HRA_METRO_PERCENT if rent_city_is_metro else HRA_NON_METRO_PERCENT
            city_limit = basic_plus_da * city_percent
            hra_exempt = min(hra_received, excess_rent, city_limit)
            if hra_exempt < 0:
                hra_exempt = Decimal('0')

    taxable_salary_before_std = gross_salary - hra_exempt
    if not is_new_regime and hra_exempt > 0:
        trace.append({
            "kind": "income",
            "description": "Less: HRA exempt",
            "amount": str(-hra_exempt),
            "clause": "Sec 10(13A)"
        })

    # 3. Standard Deduction
    std_deduction = STD_DEDUCTION_NEW if is_new_regime else STD_DEDUCTION_OLD
    std_deduction = min(std_deduction, taxable_salary_before_std)
    net_salary = taxable_salary_before_std - std_deduction
    trace.append({
        "kind": "income",
        "description": "Less: Standard deduction",
        "amount": str(-std_deduction),
        "clause": "Sec 16(ia)" if not is_new_regime else "Sec 115BAC / Sec 16(ia)"
    })

    # 4. Income from House Property (Old regime only)
    hp_loss = Decimal('0')
    if not is_new_regime and home_loan_interest > 0:
        hp_loss = min(home_loan_interest, HP_INTEREST_LIMIT_OLD)
        trace.append({
            "kind": "income",
            "description": "Less: Loss from self-occupied house property set off",
            "amount": str(-hp_loss),
            "clause": "Sec 24(b) and Sec 71(3A)"
        })

    gross_total_income = max(Decimal('0'), net_salary - hp_loss)

    # 5. Chapter VI-A Deductions (Old regime only)
    deductions_total = Decimal('0')
    if not is_new_regime:
        d_80c = min(sec_80c, SEC_80C_LIMIT)
        d_80ccd_1b = min(sec_80ccd_1b, SEC_80CCD_1B_LIMIT)
        
        self_limit = SEC_80D_SELF_SR_LIMIT if age >= 60 else SEC_80D_SELF_LIMIT
        d_80d_self = min(health_ins_self, self_limit)
        
        parents_limit = SEC_80D_PARENTS_SR_LIMIT if parents_senior else SEC_80D_PARENTS_LIMIT
        d_80d_parents = min(health_ins_parents, parents_limit)
        
        d_80d = d_80d_self + d_80d_parents
        
        raw_deductions = d_80c + d_80ccd_1b + d_80d
        deductions_total = min(raw_deductions, gross_total_income) # Sec 80A(2) overall cap

        if d_80c > 0:
            trace.append({
                "kind": "income",
                "description": "Deduction under Sec 80C",
                "amount": str(-d_80c),
                "clause": "Sec 80C"
            })
        if d_80ccd_1b > 0:
            trace.append({
                "kind": "income",
                "description": "Deduction under Sec 80CCD(1B)",
                "amount": str(-d_80ccd_1b),
                "clause": "Sec 80CCD(1B)"
            })
        if d_80d > 0:
            trace.append({
                "kind": "income",
                "description": "Deduction under Sec 80D",
                "amount": str(-d_80d),
                "clause": "Sec 80D"
            })

    unrounded_total_income = max(Decimal('0'), gross_total_income - deductions_total)

    # Sec 288A Rounding of total income
    total_income = round_nearest_ten(unrounded_total_income)
    income_rounding_adjustment = total_income - unrounded_total_income
    if income_rounding_adjustment != 0:
        trace.append({
            "kind": "income",
            "description": "Rounding adjustment to total income",
            "amount": str(income_rounding_adjustment),
            "clause": "Sec 288A"
        })

    # 6. Tax computation
    if is_new_regime:
        slabs = SLABS_NEW
    else:
        if age >= 80:
            slabs = SLABS_OLD_SUPER_SENIOR
        elif age >= 60:
            slabs = SLABS_OLD_SENIOR
        else:
            slabs = SLABS_OLD_UNDER_60

    tax_before_rebate, slab_details = compute_slabs(total_income, slabs)
    for desc, amt in slab_details:
        trace.append({
            "kind": "tax",
            "description": desc,
            "amount": str(amt),
            "clause": "Sec 115BAC" if is_new_regime else "First Schedule, Part III, Para A"
        })

    # 7. Sec 87A Rebate & Marginal Relief
    rebate = Decimal('0')
    if is_new_regime:
        if total_income <= REBATE_NEW_LIMIT:
            rebate = min(tax_before_rebate, REBATE_NEW_MAX)
        else:
            # Marginal relief for new regime rebate under Sec 87A
            excess_income = total_income - REBATE_NEW_LIMIT
            if tax_before_rebate > excess_income:
                rebate = tax_before_rebate - excess_income
    else:
        if total_income <= REBATE_OLD_LIMIT:
            rebate = min(tax_before_rebate, REBATE_OLD_MAX)

    if rebate > 0:
        trace.append({
            "kind": "tax",
            "description": "Less: Rebate under Sec 87A",
            "amount": str(-rebate),
            "clause": "Sec 87A"
        })

    tax_after_rebate = max(Decimal('0'), tax_before_rebate - rebate)

    # 8. Surcharge & Surcharge Marginal Relief
    surcharge = Decimal('0')
    surcharge_rates = SURCHARGE_RATES_NEW if is_new_regime else SURCHARGE_RATES_OLD
    
    applicable_threshold = None
    applicable_surcharge_rate = Decimal('0')
    for thresh, rate in zip(SURCHARGE_THRESHOLDS, surcharge_rates):
        if total_income > thresh:
            applicable_threshold = thresh
            applicable_surcharge_rate = rate

    if applicable_threshold is not None:
        surcharge = tax_after_rebate * applicable_surcharge_rate
        trace.append({
            "kind": "tax",
            "description": f"Surcharge at {applicable_surcharge_rate * Decimal('100')}%",
            "amount": str(surcharge),
            "clause": "First Schedule"
        })

        # Surcharge Marginal Relief check
        # Compare (tax + surcharge) with (tax on threshold + surcharge on threshold at LOWER rate) + (income - threshold)
        # Note: at the first threshold (50L), the lower rate is 0%. For higher thresholds, find the preceding rate.
        idx = SURCHARGE_THRESHOLDS.index(applicable_threshold)
        lower_rate = surcharge_rates[idx - 1] if idx > 0 else Decimal('0')
        
        tax_at_thresh, _ = compute_slabs(applicable_threshold, slabs)
        surcharge_at_thresh = tax_at_thresh * lower_rate
        total_at_thresh = tax_at_thresh + surcharge_at_thresh
        
        max_allowed_total = total_at_thresh + (total_income - applicable_threshold)
        actual_total = tax_after_rebate + surcharge
        
        if actual_total > max_allowed_total:
            surcharge_relief = actual_total - max_allowed_total
            surcharge -= surcharge_relief
            trace.append({
                "kind": "tax",
                "description": "Less: Surcharge marginal relief",
                "amount": str(-surcharge_relief),
                "clause": "First Schedule (Marginal Relief)"
            })

    tax_plus_surcharge = tax_after_rebate + surcharge

    # 9. Health and Education Cess
    cess = (tax_plus_surcharge * CESS_RATE).quantize(Decimal('0.01'), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
    if cess > 0:
        trace.append({
            "kind": "tax",
            "description": "Health and Education Cess at 4%",
            "amount": str(cess),
            "clause": "Finance Act"
        })

    unrounded_tax_payable = tax_plus_surcharge + cess

    # Sec 288B Rounding of tax payable
    tax_payable = round_nearest_ten(unrounded_tax_payable)
    tax_rounding_adjustment = tax_payable - unrounded_tax_payable
    if tax_rounding_adjustment != 0:
        trace.append({
            "kind": "tax",
            "description": "Rounding adjustment to tax payable",
            "amount": str(tax_rounding_adjustment),
            "clause": "Sec 288B"
        })

    return {
        "total_income": int(total_income),
        "tax_payable": int(tax_payable),
        "trace": trace
    }


def compute(inp: dict) -> dict:
    old_result = compute_regime(inp, is_new_regime=False)
    new_result = compute_regime(inp, is_new_regime=True)
    return {
        "old": old_result,
        "new": new_result
    }
